summary.headline: Deep Industries Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue rose 33.7% YoY to INR295.43 crores; FY27 operating revenue guided up 30-35% on INR3,089 crore order book.
summary.overview: Consolidated Q2 FY27 revenue from operations was INR295.43 crores (up 33.7% YoY) and H1 was INR574.34 crores (up 36.6%). Q2 EBITDA was INR124 crores at a 39.6% margin and H1 EBITDA was INR255.83 crores at 41.6%, with PAT of INR81.22 crores in Q2 and INR170.37 crores in H1. Management attributed the soft Q2 profit growth to project transition timing and repair costs, and said growth should pick up from Q3 with the production enhancement contract for ONGC. Management reiterated FY27 and FY28 guidance of 30-35% revenue growth, with FY27 PAT of INR350-370 crores and FY28 PAT of INR470-500 crores.

financial_highlights.metric: Consolidated revenue from operations, Q2 FY27
Consolidated revenue from operations, H1 FY27
Free cash flow from operations, H1 FY27

segments.name: Production enhancement (ONGC PEC contract)
segments.commentary: 15-year INR1,402 crore contract taken over April 2025; Mori 5 incident delayed incremental production by 5-6 months. Management expects contribution from Q3 FY27, around INR50-60 crores in H2 FY27 and about INR150 crores full-year revenue in FY28. Capex of about INR150 crores is planned.

segments.name: Gas compression
segments.commentary: Fleet of over 80 compressors, the largest in India; Deep executes close to 85% of the roughly 30% outsourced compression market. Management guides this division to grow 25-35% per year on average.

segments.name: Drilling and workover rigs
segments.commentary: Fleet of 20 onshore rigs (14 workover, 6 drilling), fully utilized. Entry into higher-capacity drilling rigs is being pursued through a JV with an overseas partner, which is not in guidance.

segments.name: Offshore (Dolphin Offshore)
segments.commentary: Step-down subsidiary since control in January 2023 via NCLT; DP2 barge Prabha operating. Management expects a few more long-term charter contracts and plans INR100-200 crores of capex only once a contract is awarded.

segments.name: Gas processing / charter hire and dehydration
segments.commentary: Charter-hire model (no upfront operator capex) with ONGC and Vedanta facilities; dehydration qualified. Management is evaluating CBG opportunities under the GOBARdhan scheme.

guidance_outlook: FY27 consolidated operating revenue growth of 30-35%, with PAT of INR350-370 crores (per management statement).
FY28 operating revenue growth of 30-35% over FY27, with PAT of INR470-500 crores; FY28 guidance excludes higher-capacity drilling rigs.
Consolidated EBITDA margin guided at 42-43% on an annual basis; quarterly variance of 300-400 bps is possible.
More than 90% of FY28 revenue growth is said to be covered by the existing order book.

Capex of about INR150 crores for PEC contracts plus about INR150 crores for rigs and compressors, contingent on contract awards; capex to be funded by internal accruals and debt, with no equity raise planned.
Bidding pipeline for FY27-FY28 stated at INR700-800 crores.
capex_capacity: Over 80 gas compressors; the company says it is near full utilization.
20 onshore rigs (14 workover, 6 drilling), fully utilized.
INR150 crore PEC capex, partly incurred in H1, with the remainder to flow as production enhancement ramps up.
INR100-200 crore Dolphin Offshore capex, contingent on contract awards; asset identification is done.
Management said it will not overtrade by buying compressors or rigs before a contract is secured.
demand_pricing: Management sees a multi-year demand runway from government policy: the Samudra Manthan offshore exploration scheme (INR84,084 crore through FY2030-31), the OLAP bidding rounds, and the shift to exploration-first.
India's crude import dependence reached a record 88.7%; the crude import bill rose 48.4% YoY to USD74.8 billion in April-August.
The PEC tender originally due in September has been extended to around end-November; management expects new PEC tenders in the next quarter.
Management said pricing for compressors is fixed from day 1 of a contract.
Management cited traction in the Middle East, Africa and Venezuela for gas processing exports, but gave no size or timing.

qa_highlights.question: Where will growth come from in Q3 and Q4 given the soft Q2?
qa_highlights.answer: Revenue from projects added in Q1 and Q2 will start to show, and PEC contribution starts from Q3; management says H2 should be better than H1.

qa_highlights.question: Why was EBITDA margin soft in Q2?
qa_highlights.answer: Project-based business with equipment transitions between projects, plus repair and maintenance costs in some quarters; management asks investors to judge on a yearly basis (42-43% guided).

qa_highlights.question: Dolphin receivables: are they collectible or to be written off?
qa_highlights.answer: Positive response on collections; ECL provisions are made but no write-offs have been considered yet.

qa_highlights.question: Status of Kandla chemical facility and RAAS Equipment?
qa_highlights.answer: Kandla production revival has started, with contribution expected around Q4; RAAS Equipment is pursuing CGD opportunities and has sold units on which it earns O&M.

qa_highlights.question: Why is the company not bidding for higher-capacity drilling rigs alone?
qa_highlights.answer: Qualification requirements from oil companies apply, not capability. Deep is forming a JV with an overseas company and will gain qualifications after completing one contract.

qa_highlights.question: Is FY28 guidance secured, and what capex and return is expected on the PEC?
qa_highlights.answer: More than 90% of FY28 growth is covered by the existing order book. The contract runs 15 years, with full-year revenue of about INR150 crores from FY28.

risks_watch: Production enhancement ramp-up depends on drilling new wells after the Mori 5 delay; incremental production expected from Q3.
PEC tender extension to around end-November, and the award outcome, drive the H2 and FY28 growth case.
Quarterly EBITDA volatility of 300-400 bps from project transitions and maintenance costs.
Dolphin Offshore receivables still carry ECL provisions and no write-off is taken yet.
Higher-capacity rig entry depends on the JV and qualification timing, and is excluded from guidance.
Global energy supply disruption (Strait of Hormuz) raises shipping, logistics and insurance costs.
summary.management_tone: Confident and forward-looking on policy tailwinds and guidance, while cautious on quarterly margins and deflecting specifics on hydrogen and CBG sizing and the timing of PEC awards. Management repeatedly asked analysts to judge performance annually rather than quarterly.
key_quotes: Based on existing order book of approx INR3,089 crores, operating revenue is expected to grow in the range of 30% to 35% in FY27.
Our EBITDA margins on a yearly basis would expect it to be in the range of 42% to 43% as per our guidance.
So in Deep, the capex would be met through internal accruals and debt only.
I think more than 90% is secured by existing order book itself.

adds.what: PEC (ONGC production enhancement) capex of about INR150 crore, partly incurred in H1, contributing from Q3 FY27
INR100-200 crore Dolphin Offshore vessel capex, contingent on a long-term charter award; asset identification done

growth.why: FY27 operating revenue guided up 30-35% (raised from 18-20% standalone), backed by a INR3,089 crore order book with >90% of FY28 growth covered, and the ONGC PEC contract contributing INR50-60 crore in H2 FY27 and ~INR150 crore in FY28, with rig and compressor capex only after contract awards.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: Management guides annual EBITDA margin at 42-43% versus H1 FY27 at 41.6%, but flags quarterly swings of 300-400 bps and Q2 margin was 39.6%, so expansion is not assured.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: PEC production enhancement (ONGC, INR1,402 crore 15-year contract) starts contributing from Q3 FY27 with INR50-60 crore in H2 FY27 and about INR150 crore in FY28, against INR150 crore PEC capex partly incurred in H1.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: FY27 operating revenue guided up 30-35% with H1 revenue up 36.6% and a INR3,089 crore order book; more than 90% of FY28 growth covered by existing order book; gas compression guided to grow 25-35% a year.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: About INR150 crore rig and compressor capex plus INR100-200 crore Dolphin vessel capex are planned but contingent on contract awards, with PEC tender extended to around end-November; fleet of 20 rigs and 80+ compressors is fully utilised.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: FY27 operating revenue growth guidance was raised to 30-35% (from 18-20% standalone), but FY27 PAT of INR350-370 crore was held, and H1 PAT is INR170.37 crore, so any upgrade depends on H2 delivery.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: PEC tender award timing has slipped (originally September, now around end-November), Mori 5 delay pushed incremental production 5-6 months, and quarterly EBITDA can swing 300-400 bps.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: Higher-capacity drilling rig entry via an overseas JV is being pursued but is excluded from guidance and requires qualification after completing one contract; CBG and Kandla revival (contribution around Q4) are under evaluation.

rows.label: INR3,089 crore order book; PEC H2 contribution
rows.why: Order book of INR3,089 crore covers more than 90% of FY28 revenue growth, and PEC adds INR50-60 crore in H2 FY27 and about INR150 crore in FY28.

rows.label: Compressor pricing fixed from day 1
rows.why: Management said compressor pricing is fixed from day one of a contract, which protects margin on new contracts while raw-material and shipping costs rise with the Strait of Hormuz disruption.

rows.label: Capex funded by internal accruals and debt, no equity
rows.why: About INR300 crore of combined capex (PEC INR150 crore plus rigs and compressors INR150 crore) is to be funded from internal accruals and debt against H1 free cash flow of INR155 crore.

tone.note: Management was confident on the policy tailwinds, the INR3,089 crore order book and the 30-35% FY27 revenue guide, but cautious on quarterly margins and vague on CBG, hydrogen and PEC award timing; analysts pressed on Q2 margin softness and the Dolphin receivables.
